# Field

Wraps any control with label, required mark, helper text and error text — the one way to label form controls.

`KenosUI.Field` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Field>…</KenosUI.Field>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Field">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Label + control + helper/error text for any control (Input, Select, Textarea, InputGroup …).

## Props (FieldProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `helperText` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `errorText` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |
| `required` | `boolean` | Adds a red * after the label. |
| `orientation` | `"vertical" \| "horizontal"` | "horizontal" = label left (width var(--field-label-width, 10rem)). |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactElement` | One control; it receives the field's id. |
